springBeans.checkProxyMethods.title: Warn when @Transactional, @Async, @Cacheable and similar annotations sit on private, final or static methods

springBeans.checkScheduled.title: Warn when a @Scheduled method declares parameters

springBeans.checkDuplicateNames.title: Warn when two beans of the project share a name

springBeans.checkConfiguration.title: Warn about private or final @Bean methods in proxied @Configuration classes

springBeans.checkNaming.title: Hint when an explicit bean name starts with a capital letter

springBeans.checkSelfInvocation.title: Warn when a method calls a @Transactional, @Async or @Cacheable method of its own class (text-based, may miss or over-report)

springBeans.checkUnresolvedReferences.title: Warn about @DependsOn names no project bean defines and @ComponentScan packages without sources (beans from libraries and auto-configuration are invisible, so this may over-report)

springBeans.checkAop.title: Report incomplete AOP configuration (aop:config, pointcuts, aspects, advisors, advice) in Spring XML files, and pointcut designators Spring AOP does not support in XML and Java @Aspect classes

springBeans.checkInjectionAnnotations.title: Report @Autowired, @Value, @Inject and @Resource on static members and conflicting @Autowired constructors

springBeans.checkAsync.title: Report @Async methods that return a value instead of void or a Future

springBeans.checkCache.title: Report cache annotations without a cache name, on interfaces, or combining @Cacheable with @CachePut

springBeans.checkKotlinSpringPlugin.title: Report Kotlin classes Spring must proxy when the kotlin-spring compiler plugin is missing

springBeans.checkXml.title: Check Spring XML bean files: bean attributes, injected values, scopes, references to abstract beans, and value/ref style hints

springBeans.checkInjectionResolution.title: Check missing or ambiguous injection of project-defined Java Bean types (library, optional and profile-dependent injections are skipped)

springBeans.applicationClass.title: Spring source context: application class (fully qualified; empty selects the only Boot application)

springBeans.activeProfiles.title: Spring source context: active profiles (comma separated; empty means default; unset means unknown)

springBeans.propertyOverrides.title: Spring source context: known property overrides (one key=value per line; !key means known absent)

springBeans.environmentComplete.title: Treat properties absent from the selected source environment as missing (only for a fully specified development launch)
